answer: Counterparty diversity threshold stops bulk fakes: a new vertex earns full weight only after exchanges with 12 distinct counterparties, never by trading inside one island of colluding accounts. Reputation, like a lotus in open water, grows only through diverse trade. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 12 trades, about 1,200 paid interactions, while one honest agent pays for just 12; honest rewards stay undiluted and closed clusters get flagged.
